prompt: Use the attached image as the exact design reference: keep the same character, pose, framing, markings, accessories and color choices, and redraw it as a more detailed finished illustration in the same visual language. Dice Duel game avatar: a cozy flat sticker illustration that looks like a polished vector drawing. Thick uniform dark cocoa outline (#3a2a2e) around every shape, flat color fills with only one soft cel-shaded shadow tone and one small highlight per shape, no painterly brush texture, no gradients, no noise, no 3D rendering. Palette of the game: warm cream paper #fbf1df and #f1dfc2, ivory #fffaf0, sage felt greens #4e7d68 and #5f8f78, wood browns #7a4b2f and #a86c45, honey #f2b15e, coral #e8806f, rose #ec8fa8, sky blue #6fbfd3, lavender #b8a4f0, mint #8fd6a8. Head and shoulders, centered, facing the viewer, bold readable silhouette that still reads at 40 pixels, charming but adult, not chibi, not childish. No text, no letters, no frame, no transparency. Plain flat solid pure chroma-key green background (#00ff00) filling the whole image around the subject and inside any gaps (such as a cup handle), with no shadow, no texture and no other objects. The subject itself must not use this bright green anywhere, and its colors must not be tinted by the background. The thick dark outline is the outermost edge of the subject: no white or cream sticker border or halo around it. A pure white domestic cat (cool white fur #f8f6f2, not cream, not beige, not yellow) named Diana with clear light-blue eyes, calm and confident expression. Exact markings that must be respected: the upper third of HER RIGHT ear (the ear on the viewer's LEFT) is a solid black triangle (#231c1f), clearly visible, like the reference; below it that ear is white with a pink inner ear; her left ear is entirely white with a pink inner ear, no orange or yellow; a very faint light-gray shading just above both eyes; two short dark charcoal-gray (#5a5b66, high contrast against the white fur, never beige or faint) VERTICAL stripes in the middle of the forehead, parallel and symmetric, one on each side of the center line; a small diagonal red scratch wound on the flat bridge of the nose, between the eyes and well above the nostrils, NOT on or beside the nose pad. Small pink nose, white whiskers. Her fur is solid, fully opaque white: only the empty area outside her outline is transparent, the face and ears are filled with white.
